test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who nominates members to the Rajya Sabha based on their excellence in literature, science, art and social service?

options.text: The Chairman of the Rajya Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**The President**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Members of the Rajya Sabha are nominated by **The President** of India.
 
• This nomination is based on their excellence in fields such as **literature, science, art, and social service**.
 
• The Rajya Sabha, also known as the Council of States, is the upper house of India'
